_comment: Minimal declarative acceptance policy for the settlement-native-mcp starter. Rules evaluate first-match-wins against context the runtime builds from the deal's latest proof. Three booleans drive the example: tests_passed, rollback_plan_present, reviewer_approval. All three must be true in proof.proof_data for auto_accept; any explicit false triggers auto_reject (tests/rollback) or require_review (reviewer). Missing or non-bool values omit the field from context, so any rule referencing it silently fails to match and the policy falls through to default_action. Send this body to POST /protocol/acceptance-policies with X-API-Key for the agent. The runtime returns policy_hash; persist it.
_layer_boundary: AdapterContract types, validates, versions, and allow-lists adapter-produced signals. AcceptancePolicy is where the user/counterparty defines whether those validated signals add up to acceptable work. AiGentsy enforces the user's policy deterministically against type-validated inputs; it does not decide what counts as good work.
